item.title: Diagnostics
item.description: Diagnostics is a single ledger of every attempt DefectDojo makes to talk to something outside itself — and of the attempts other systems make to talk to it. When a ticket never appeared, a scan never imported, or a user could not sign in, this is the page that says what happened, when, to which configuration, and who set it off.
